intro: A biography of Elena Vidal, an invented botanist who spent her life studying plants. All the past tenses at work.
b1.texto:
- The **indefinido** carries the milestones: **nació**, **se licenció**, **falleció**.
- The **imperfecto** gives the background to one of them: cuando **tenía** diez años…
- The **passive** fits public events: **fue nombrada**, **fue aprobado**.
- What someone argued for or asked for goes in the **past subjunctive**: defendió que los visitantes **pudieran** tocar las plantas; le pidieron que **esperara**.
- A **compound infinitive** looks back: sin **haber podido** volver.

Useful biography words: **nacer**, **criarse**, **licenciarse**, **casarse**, **trasladarse**, **fallecer**; **a los** treinta años; **en** 1931; **tras** la jubilación; **al** cerrarse el jardín.
b2.f0: Elena Vidal was born in Valencia in 1888, into a modest family.
b2.f1: When she was ten her father died, so she had to leave school and start working.
b2.f2: She was a seamstress, a shop assistant and a telephone operator before going back to study.
b2.f3: In spite of the difficulties, she graduated in Biology at the age of thirty-six.
b2.f4: In 1931 she was appointed director of the botanical garden and argued there that visitors should be able to touch the plants.
b2.f5: Many colleagues, even from her own department, asked her to wait.
b2.f6: She refused, and the project for the new herbarium was approved on 1 October 1931.
b2.f7: When she retired she moved to Switzerland with her sister; she fell ill soon after and died there in 1972 without having been able to return.
b4.pregunta: Why did Clara have to leave school?
b4.o0.refuerzo: Murió su padre, por lo que tuvo que dejar la escuela.
b4.o1.refuerzo: Failing exams is not the reason; the correct answer is about a family event and work.
b4.o2.refuerzo: Moving abroad is not the reason; the correct answer is about her father and having to work.
b5.pregunta: How old was she when she graduated in Law?
b5.o0.refuerzo: A los treinta y seis años.
b5.o1.refuerzo: The text says treinta y seis.
b5.o2.refuerzo: The text says treinta y seis.
b6.pregunta: What did many colleagues ask her to do?
b6.o1.refuerzo: Resigning is not what colleagues asked; they asked her to wait.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Changing the plan is not what colleagues asked; the correct request was to wait.
b7.pregunta: Why «pudieran» and not «podían» in «defendió que los visitantes pudieran tocar las plantas»?
b7.o0.refuerzo: What you argue for takes the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: A guess would use the conditional.
b8.pregunta: Complete: she graduated at the age of thirty-six.
b8.o0.refuerzo: A los … años: at the age of.
b8.o1.refuerzo: Age takes a: a los treinta y seis años.
b8.o2.refuerzo: Age takes a: a los treinta y seis años.
b9.o0: without having been able to return
b9.o0.explicacion: Sin haber podido volver means without having been able to return.
b9.o1.explicacion: Poder is to be able, not to want.
b10.traduccion: The herbarium project was approved in 1931.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the biography of a person you admire, in an organised text with dates and turning points.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud the story of your own life in three minutes, choosing what to include.
